activity.overview: Split shapes into equal shares. Use the words halves and fourths.

problems.prompt: Draw a circle. Split it into 2 equal shares. What do we call each share?
Draw a rectangle. Split it into 4 equal shares. What do we call each share?
Two friends share a sandwich. They cut it into 2 parts, but one part is much bigger. Did they cut it in halves? Tell why.
A pizza is cut into 4 equal shares. You eat 1 share. How much of the pizza did you eat?
Which is bigger: one half of a pizza or one fourth of the same pizza? Tell why.
